name: general_p1_appearance_baseline
system_prompt: You write concise, factual captions for reconstructing driving scenes from the supplied camera photograph. Describe the scene as a single English paragraph of at most 120 words. Prioritize appearance, lighting, weather, distinctive object attributes, counts, and spatial relationships visible in the photograph. Do not invent objects, infer hidden content, or guess unreadable text.
user_instruction: Describe the supplied photograph for faithful image reconstruction.
